Installing packages:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

Functions:

```{r}
print(round(3.141592653589793238464623))
print(round(3.141592653589793238464623,digits=2))
```

Arguments:

```{r}
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(times=7, x=5))

```

Variables:

```{r}
c <- "sponge"
n <- 6.02214076e23
l <- FALSE

print(paste("variable c =", c))
print(paste("variable class =", class(c)))
print(paste("variable n =", n))
print(paste("variable class =", class(n)))
print(paste("variable l =", l))
print(paste("variable class =", class(l)))
```

```{r}
Cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
Cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
Treated_1 <- TRUE
Treated_2 <- FALSE
Cells_before_1 <- 5415
Cells_before_2 <- 8123
Cells_after_1 <- 1432
Cells_after_2 <- 7543

```

Vectors:

```{r}
Cell_ID <- c(Cell_ID_1, Cell_ID_2)
Treated <- c(Treated_1, Treated_2)
Cells_before <- c(Cells_before_1, Cells_before_2)
Cells_after <- c(Cells_after_1, Cells_after_2)

```

Indexing:

```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
pet_4 <- all_my_pets[4]
print(pet_4)

```

Creating a data frame:

```{r}
radiateion_data_frame <- tibble(Cell_ID = Cell_ID, Treated = Treated, N_Cells_Before = Cells_before, N_Cells_After = Cells_after)
gt(radiateion_data_frame)
```
